text.p: Standard Bank Investment Corp said on Tuesday it expected a satisfactory increase in earnings in the 1997 financial year despite a continuation of last year's tough market conditions.
"The difficult market conditions in the second half of 1996 continued into the early part of 1997," Stanbic group chief executive Mike Vosloo said.
"Nevertheless, a satisfactory increase in earnings is expected in 1997."

Stanbic earlier released results for the six months to end December showing headline earnings per share rising to 1,311 cents from 1,053 cents before -- just above a Reuters poll of analysts who had expected a rise to a consensus 1,300 cents.
The dividend climbed to 407 cents compared with a Reuters poll of 400 cents.
